## Trigger baseline ("before") for #34769 · 2026-11-17T23:59Z

The first model round of the skill-evals runner with trigger cases (PR #35022), as ordered by seat 3. This is the **before** baseline each description change in #34769 is measured against.

- Runner and cases: PR #35022 at `8d82dcb937777118cf574ab638b7d62e44fd9c57`, workspace `skills/`.
- Driver: Claude Code CLI 2.1.326, subscription login (`oauth_token`, no API key), served `claude-haiku-5-5`, effort medium, `--max-turns 16`, 4 at once, 1 repetition.
- 476 of 476 turns ran (217 behaviour cases × 2 arms + 42 trigger cases × the with-skill arm); 34.2 min; notional cost the CLI reported $2.2 (nothing billed).
- Records: `/mnt/project-files/issue-34789/round-haiku-2026-11-17/` (`round.json`, `summary.md`, `summary.github.md`, one `runs/*.json` per turn). Re-grade with `skill-evals --regrade DIR`.

### Trigger cases, per skill

| skill | cases | loaded when it should | left alone when it should not | false loads (case) |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|:--|
| objectstack-automation | 7 | 5/5 | 2/2 | none |
| objectstack-data | 7 | 5/5 | 1/2 | `triggers#6` |
| objectstack-formula | 7 | 5/5 | 1/2 | `triggers#6` |
| objectstack-i18n | 7 | 5/5 | 2/2 | none |
| objectstack-query | 7 | 5/5 | 1/2 | `triggers#7` |
| objectstack-ui | 7 | 5/5 | 1/2 | `triggers#6` |
| **all** | 42 | **30/30 (100%)** | **8/12 (67%)** | 4 |

- No missed load. Of the 30 loads, 24 came through the `Skill` tool and 6 by reading a file under `.claude/skills/BUNDLE/` only.
- All 4 false loads were by reading only: the model browsed the skill's files on a question the skill should not answer, without launching it. A description change can move launches; whether it moves browsing is part of what #34769 should read. With one repetition, each negative is a single turn, so one flip moves a skill's rate by 50 points: compare with `--repeats 3` before calling a change.

### Behaviour cases, for reference (same round)

With-skill 130/215 (60%), no-skill 9/217 (4%), 2 errors out of the denominator. Per bundle: ai 6/8, api 3/7, ask 2/7, automation 17/25, data 25/44, formula 8/12, i18n 8/11, platform 8/23, query 5/8, ui 26/32, upgrade 2/5, objectui 20/33. These are the cases after #35022's assertion review; the per-case table is in `summary.md`.
